Tim Hardaway is 59 years old.

Tim Hardaway was born in Chicago, Illinois.

Tim Hardaway was born on September 1, 1966.

Tim Hardaway is 6-0 (183 cm) tall.

How much did Tim Hardaway weigh when playing?

Tim Hardaway weighed 175 lbs (79 kg) when playing.

Tim Hardaway was inducted to the Hall of Fame as a Player in 2022 (Full List) .

Tim Hardaway was drafted by Golden State Warriors, 1st round (14th pick, 14th overall), 1989 NBA Draft.

What position did Tim Hardaway play?

Point Guard.

When did Tim Hardaway retire?

Tim Hardaway last played in 2003.

What is Tim Hardaway's net worth?

Tim Hardaway made at least $46,661,390 playing professional basketball.

Tim Hardaway made $12,000,000 in 2001.

What did Tim Hardaway average?

Tim Hardaway averaged 17.7 points, 3.3 rebounds, and 8.2 assists per game.

How many rings does Tim Hardaway have?

Tim Hardaway won 0 championships.

What schools did Tim Hardaway attend?

Tim Hardaway attended Carver in Chicago, Illinois and Texas-El Paso.
